pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to losing positions or placing multiple correlated tickets within a 5-pip range during active trend continuation.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entry authorized unless the 14-period ATR volatility expansion filter is confirmed and order book imbalance exceeds 65% in the direction of the trade.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing stop-loss locking once open profit reaches +$12.00, targeting asymmetrical exits in the +$15.00 to +$30.00 range.
